title: Staff create forms explain an empty pet dropdown
summary: When a Shelter case or Pet Care consultation create form has no pet to choose, staff now see an explanation and a link to add a pet, then return to the original form with that pet ready to use.
changes: Show a clear empty state on staff Shelter case and Pet Care consultation create forms when no pet profiles are available.
Let staff add a pet first and return to the original create form with that pet selected.
affected_areas: Shelter and Pet Care pet profile create
version_rationale: Patch release: explains an empty staff pet dropdown and restores the create flow without changing public own-record pages.
validation: PHPUnit StaffEmptyPetSelectTest covers empty-state copy, the add-pet return path, public users keeping a blank select, and rejected external return addresses.
PHPUnit StaffPetCreateReturnTest covers the allowed return keys.
PHPUnit AuthorizationRuntimeSourceContractTest confirms staff empty-state detection uses permission checks instead of scalar access helpers.
php artisan myapes:changelog-validate --base-ref=origin/main on the PR branch.
known_limitations: Public own-record empty pet dropdowns are unchanged until a later ticket.
rollback: Redeploy the previous application version to restore blank pet dropdowns on staff create forms and remove the add-pet return path.
provenance: Empty staff pet dropdown fix for issue #143, pull request #210.
